title: Cable families: Positive proof strip
summary: Union-find components. Return only numbers greater than 0 from the result list.
descriptionMd:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
links is a square table of 0s and 1s. Points are numbered from 0. A 1 at links[a][b] joins points a and b in both directions. A 0 means no link. k is included in the function call, but this task does not use it. You can ignore it.

Step 1: Build the result list
This graph has two-way links between points. Points belong to the same group if you can travel between them, even through other points. Use union-find: start with one group per point, then join groups when a link connects them. For each point, count all points in its group, including itself. Record these counts in point order. A link from a point to itself does not make a larger group. A graph with no points gives an empty result list.

Step 2: Return the answer
Return only numbers greater than 0 from the result list. Keep their order and any repeated numbers. If none matches, return [].

Write your function
Complete cableFamiliesPositiveProofStrip(links, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.

Start with the first card. The last card also uses position numbers that start at 1.
constraints: k is a whole number from 1 to 8. Answers fit in a signed 32-bit integer: -2,147,483,648 through 2,147,483,647.
Input numbers have no decimal part. They range from -1,000,000 to 1,000,000. Follow any extra input rules in Step 1.
The graph has at most 16 points. Its table has the same number of rows and columns. Link entries are 0 or 1; cost entries are 0 through 13.

Efficiency goal: time O(V^2 alpha(V)); extra memory, including the result list, O(n). n is the input length; V is the number of graph points. These labels describe how work and memory grow with the input.
hints: Try a small example by hand. Follow Step 1 and write down its result list.
